extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from the extraction job: FS8205A, TECH PUBLIC, dual n-channel enhancement power MOSFET, LCSC C2830320.
The supplied three-page datasheet contains specification tables and package or circuit diagrams but no usable transfer, output, or capacitance plots; curves are therefore omitted.

The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for absolute maximum ratings, switching characteristics, gate charge, thermal resistance, package dimensions, or other table rows outside the required fields; those fields were not added outside schema.
extraction.omission_reason: The three-page supplied FS8205A datasheet contains no plotted transfer, output, or capacitance curves. It contains only electrical-characteristic tables, a circuit diagram, and package drawings, so no curve points can be extracted without inventing data.
